signals.summary: Watch the bizarre moment Morocco's press conference was disrupted by two journalists arguing, leading to a very perplexed-looking Brahim Diaz.

signals.title: Restoring Dignity - Senegalese Surgeon and Burundian Foundation Win Reproductive Health Awards
signals.summary: [UN News] A Senegalese surgeon who has dedicated his career to restoring the health and dignity of women living with obstetric fistula, and a Burundian foundation supporting vulnerable women and children, have been named the winners of the 2026 United Nations Population Award.

signals.title: Madagascar: le gouvernement promet d’«en finir» avec des vagues d'assassinats et de disparitions relayés sur Internet
signals.summary: Les autorités malgaches ont décidé d'employer la manière forte face à la multiplication des disparitions et assassinats – en particulier d’enfants – rapportés ces dernières semaines sur les réseaux sociaux : 90 signalements pour disparitions ont été recensés récemment rien que dans la capitale. Sur ce total, 43 personnes ont été retrouvées. Le Premier ministre a également pris la parole, affirmant notamment que ces crimes étaient destinés à nuire au régime de transition.

signals.title: Côte d'Ivoire Secures $50m Climate Funding for Agriculture
signals.summary: [Daba Finance] Côte d'Ivoire secured $50 million from the Green Climate Fund to support a 5-year program aimed at helping farmers adapt to climate change and cut emissions from agriculture.

signals.title: Uniwax Posts Loss After Tax Treatment Reverses 2025 Profit
signals.summary: [Daba Finance] Uniwax Côte d'Ivoire (BRVM: UNXC) ended 2025 with a net loss of 624 million CFA francs, even after reporting quarterly profits that pointed to a rebound during the year.

signals.title: Mali Approves $190m Power Grid Project for Bamako
signals.summary: [Daba Finance] Mali's transitional parliament approved financing agreements with the African Development Bank Group for a $190 million power grid project aimed at improving electricity supply in Bamako and nearby areas.

signals.title: Mali Creates Gold Agency to Tighten Control of Exports
signals.summary: [Daba Finance] Mali's transitional parliament approved a law creating the Malian Office of Precious Substances, a new state agency that will regulate and secure the sale of gold and other precious minerals.

signals.title: Senegal Oil Output Reaches 17.9m Barrels in First Half
signals.summary: [Daba Finance] Senegal produced 17.9 million barrels of crude oil from its Sangomar field in the first 6 months of 2026, putting the country on track to meet a higher annual target, the Ministry of Petroleum and Energy said.

signals.title: Setao Côte d'Ivoire (STAC) Stock Soars +165.49 Percent in 180 Days On BRVM
signals.summary: [Daba Finance] Abidjan, Côte d'Ivoire -- Setao Côte d'Ivoire (STAC), listed on the Bourse Régionale des Valeurs Mobilières (BRVM), has delivered an exceptional long-term performance, recording a surge of +165.49% over the last 180 days. This significant upward movement positions STAC as a notable performer within the West African financial landscape.

signals.title: France Beat Stubborn Paraguay to Set Morocco Q'final Clash
signals.summary: [This Day] World Cup favourites France were made to sweat to book their quarter-final place but Kylian Mbappe's second-half penalty proved enough to help them past a resolute Paraguay in Philadelphia.

signals.title: Ounahi Double Ends Canada's World Cup Adventure As Morocco Book Quarter Final Berth
signals.summary: [This Day] Co-hosts Canada's FIFA World Cup 2026 adventure came to a end yesterday in Houston as Azzedine Ounahi's second-half double and a late Soufiane Rahimi goal sent Morocco through to the quarter-finals for a second straight tournament.

signals.title: Why Morocco Deserves World's Attention
signals.summary: [This Day] Every football match has statistics. Every tournament has history. But only a few of us have had the privilege of living part of that history.

signals.title: BRVM Rally Continues As Composite Index Nears 460 Points
signals.summary: [Daba Finance] The BRVM extended its rally in the week ended July 3, with all major indices rising as buyers remained active across the regional exchange. The benchmark Composite gained 2.20% to 459.70 points, while the BRVM 30 rose 2.36% to 216.15 points. The BRVM Prestige advanced 0.70% to 176.37 points, and the BRVM Principal posted the strongest index performance, rising 3.81% to 333.69 points.

signals.title: BRVM-Listed Filtisac Shuts Spinning Unit As Profit Falls
signals.summary: [Daba Finance] Filtisac SA will close its spinning workshop as the Ivorian packaging company restructures its jute business after a sharp drop in profit and cash flow.

signals.summary: Fishing crews in Sierra Leone say large Chinese ships are illegally hoovering up stocks.

signals.summary: More than 2,000 primary schools are facing closure as enrolment numbers plummet.

signals.summary: Six fans of the Black Stars are living proof of how football can drive supporters to extreme lengths to follow their team.

signals.title: World Cup - Belgium Stage Dramatic Comeback to Eliminate Senegal After Extra Time
signals.summary: [Premium Times] Youri Tielemans converted a dramatic penalty in the 125th minute to seal Belgium's victory.

signals.title: Senegal Suffer Cruel World Cup Exit After Belgium's Late Comeback
signals.summary: [CAF] Senegal's World Cup journey ended in painful fashion after Belgium produced a remarkable late comeback to beat the Lions of Teranga 3-2 after extra time in Seattle on Wednesday.

signals.title: Senegal Squander Two-Goal Lead As Tielemans Steals the Show for Belgium
signals.summary: [RFI] Youri Tielemans scored a last-minute penalty in extra time on Wednesday to complete a remarkable three-goal comeback for Belgium against Senegal and give his side a place in the last 16 at the 2026 World Cup.
